name: SCU Vice Chancellor's Regional Leadership Scholarship
summary: $50,000 offered automatically to the top 10 regional school leavers with an ATAR of 90 or more starting full-time at SCU.
who: Commonwealth supported place or onshore international student.
Starting a full-time bachelor degree at SCU.
Live in, or finished Year 12 at a school in, Northern NSW to South East Queensland.
how: No application. Students do not have to apply for merit-based scholarships.
catches: Ten scholarships, offered to the top 10 eligible students by ATAR.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Vice Chancellor's Regional Leadership Scholarship

evidence.quote: Have achieved an ATAR of 90 or above.
Students do not have to apply for Merit-based Scholarships.
